``` {r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# Read the data
data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("Beta_Elision_Scatter.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")

# Rename columns (remove backslashes)
colnames(data) <- c("subjects", "CTOPP_2_EL_ScS", "Beta_caudate", "Beta_IFGop", "Beta_pSTG_SMG", "group")

# Convert Elision to numeric and remove n/a
data <- data %>%
  mutate(CTOPP_2_EL_ScS = as.numeric(CTOPP_2_EL_ScS)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CTOPP_2_EL_ScS))

# Define colors matching the image
colors <- c("DLD" = "#6BB8A3", "TYP" = "#E8957F")

# Plot 1: Elision vs Beta Caudate
plot1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Beta_caudate, y = CTOPP_2_EL_ScS, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21,color = "black", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Beta est. Caudate",
       y = "Elision (CTOPP-2)",
       color = "Group",
       fill = "Group") +
 
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.8),
  )

# Plot 2: Elision vs Beta IFGop
plot2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Beta_IFGop, y = CTOPP_2_EL_ScS, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21,color = "black", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Beta est. IFGop",
       y = "Elision (CTOPP-2)",
       color = "Group",
       fill = "Group") +

  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.8),
  )

# Plot 3: Elision vs Beta pSTG/SMG
plot3 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Beta_pSTG_SMG, y = CTOPP_2_EL_ScS, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20), breaks = seq(0, 20, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Beta est. SMG",
       y = "Elision (CTOPP-2)",
       color = "Group",
       fill = "Group") +

  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.8),
  )

print(plot1)
# Create combined plot with larger spacing
combined_plot <- (plot2 / plot3 / plot1) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1, 1))+
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "a",
      tag_prefix = "(",
      tag_suffix = ")"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.98)
  )

print(combined_plot)

# Display with larger size
combined_plot

# SAVE as high-resolution PNG (recommended)
ggsave("Elision_Beta_Plots.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 6, height = 10, dpi = 300)


```
